verdict.rationale: Looking up filing or case status is a fair question for a state business-filing office, but nothing in the pack shows a public status lookup on the Secretary of State's pages. The only status feature cited is OH|TAX refund status (ohio-sos-docs-6), which belongs to the separate tax agency and covers tax refunds, not business filings. The Gateway items describe login and OHID-gated workflows, and the ohiosos.gov and Business Central probes recorded only robots.txt walls, with no status-lookup surface observed.
